To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a doublestar IPM synchronous machine can be modeled with a decoupled model structure in a suitable reference frame, and that the model parameters can be determined by finite-element analysis and voltage-source inverter measurements.

• a decoupled dq model for double-star PM synchronous machines is derived and validated, • a method to determine the machine parameters by voltage-source invertors on-site is presented, • a method for the finite-element analysis is presented,

a decoupled model for double-star IPM machines can be obtained by a diagonalization of the machine inductance matrix, the diagonalization can be performed with a transformation matrix, which is derived by the eigenvalue decomposition of the inductances, the machine inductivities can be estimated by the finite-element method, and the inductivities can also be obtained by the on-site voltage-source inverters measurements.
